name: The District at Tustin Legacy
description: The District at Tustin Legacy is a premier outdoor shopping and entertainment destination located in the heart of Tustin, California. This vibrant lifestyle center offers a carefully curated mix of upscale retailers, trendy boutiques, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues in a pedestrian-friendly environment. Developed on the historic Tustin Legacy site, it combines modern amenities with open-air design, creating a dynamic social hub for Orange County residents and visitors.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Tustin offering shopping, dining, and entertainment on the historic Tustin Legacy site.
